This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Biology and appearance==
This diminutive [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by what appeared to be [[Color|dark red]] [[hair]], as well as distinctive elongated glossy red masks that only revealed their eyes, as well as unique, spiky devices attached to the backs of their thick clothing.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[2 BBY]], a trio of members of this species could be found in the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], present during the arrest of [[Ghorman]] [[senator]], [[Dasi Oran]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Red-Skinned-Species-Concept.jpg|right|250px|thumb|PILGRIM+sketch+10 by Tom Blake.]]
The species made their debut in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> directed by [[Janus Metz]] and aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The species was originally designed by [[Tom Blake]], though concept art depicts them with having blue felinoid faces while said faces are covered on the actual costumes.<ref name="Blake Portfolio">{{WebCite|url=https://www.tomblakedesign.com/design/andor2|text=STAR WARS ANDOR SEASON 2|work=[[Tom Blake]]'s [https://www.tomblakedesign.com official website]|archivedate=20250623003358}}</ref>
